'''Alliance Station I''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="JTL" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWG_JTL_Concept_Art_5.jpg|thumb|180px|right|Concept art of Rebel space stations for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''.]]
Alliance Station I was a space station in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
